mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 72 degrees with overcast skies at City Hall, and please note the moderate air quality index of 65 today under the new moon.

In city news, the Plan Commission is meeting on September 8th to review development projects including site plans for 201 South Main Street, and the City Clerk has finished accepting submissions for the I Voted sticker design contest.

We have a busy schedule with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee both happening today, followed by a full slate of activities tomorrow including the farmer's market and trivia at The Mill.
In a report on police activity, on August 6, an officer observed a vehicle driving erratically and arrested the 49-year-old driver for a fourth O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and if you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Cookie.
